name: roman_numeral
description: Convert an Arabic integer (1-39) to Roman numerals, few-shot. Control: same format but the second line is the arabic successor.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
def roman(n):
    vals=[(10,'X'),(9,'IX'),(5,'V'),(4,'IV'),(1,'I')]
    s=''
    for v,r in vals:
        while n>=v: s+=r; n-=v
    return s
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    shots=random.sample(range(1,40),3); q=random.choice([x for x in range(2,40) if x not in shots])
    p=''.join(f"Number: {a}\nRoman: {roman(a)}\n\n" for a in shots)+f"Number: {q}\nRoman:"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+roman(q)})
    p2=''.join(f"Number: {a}\nNext: {a+1}\n\n" for a in shots)+f"Number: {q}\nNext:"
    control.append({"prompt":p2,"answer":f" {q+1}"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
